task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-10 at src/design/adp-10-agent-io-capture-audit.md. Define additive audit payload_full JSONB semantics: when and how agent invocations store full input/output/tool-call payloads, compliance-sensitive raw-message handling policy hooks, null behavior for non-agent actions, and read/query compatibility guarantees with existing OBS-03 consumers. Specify payload shape/versioning, size/bounds/redaction expectations, and interaction with ADP-09 chain hashing so payload_full participates deterministically without breaking legacy rows. Include migration/index/query guidance and explicit acceptance-to-test traceability. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines deterministic capture semantics for agent I/O payload_full content and null behavior for non-agent actions
Compatibility guarantees preserve existing audit fields, queries, and OBS-03 behavior for legacy/non-agent entries
Policy hooks for compliance-sensitive raw message handling and redaction/bounds are explicit and testable
ADP-09 chain interaction is specified so payload_full inclusion/exclusion is deterministic and verifiable
Design includes traceability to ADP-10 acceptance criteria with actionable test guidance

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-10 agent I/O audit capture with deterministic payload_full semantics, compliance policy hooks, OBS-03 compatibility guarantees, ADP-09 chain-hash interaction rules, migration/index/query guidance, and acceptance-to-test traceability.
